(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly develops national-scale (entire Brazil), spatially explicit future land-use and land-cover (LULC) change scenarios until 2050 using the LuccME modeling framework. Its primary objective is LULC prediction, aligned with three SSP/RCP scenarios (SSP1/RCP1.9, SSP2/RCP4.5, SSP3/RCP7.0), enabling quantitative comparison across multiple futures. The study implements a spatial allocation model incorporating biophysical, socioeconomic, and institutional drivers at 10 km resolution, produces mapped LULC projections for six classes, and reports quantitative validation metrics (e.g., 84.44% average spatial fit, omission/commission errors). It meets all core inclusion criteria and avoids all exclusion criteria.)
